scenes.narration: At 2:17 in the morning, a trader isn't fighting the market. They're drowning in it.
scenes.visual_argument: A solitary trader isolated in a dark void while market monitors flash alert warnings. The visual establishes the universal nocturnal vulnerability of retail traders facing silent institutional capital flows.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A lone lighthouse keeper stranded in a silent ocean of nocturnal market volatility.
scenes.company_style: Locked stage archival tan and charcoal grid, B&W halftone cutout trader with rough white keyline and offset red marker shadow.
scenes.camera: Slow creeping push-in on trader's eyes reflecting cascading red market sell walls.
scenes.transition: Cut on red flash with flashing colon ':' morphing into terminal cursor.
scenes.sound: Room tone, mechanical clock tick, deep sub-bass drop at 0.2s.

scenes.narration: Every second brings twenty new headlines, hundreds of opinions, and endless conflicting charts.
scenes.visual_argument: Information physically overwhelms the trader, stacking endless layers of text, charts, and news clips until the screen is choked with noise, causing the trader to visually shrink.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The Information Flood: an avalanche of financial paperwork burying the trader alive.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama with aged financial newspaper columns, popping alert cards with spring overshoot, and flying red warning tags.
scenes.camera: Rapid camera pull-back (reverse push) exaggerating spatial claustrophobia and overwhelm.
scenes.transition: Torn newspaper headline becomes a jagged red trendline.
scenes.sound: Rapid paper rustle, accelerating mechanical ticks, digital data flood hiss.

scenes.narration: More data doesn't create clarity. It creates noise.
scenes.visual_argument: All conflicting arrows, multiplying charts, and flying headlines abruptly freeze and collapse inward to dead-center, leaving one stark centered card on a silent archival tan canvas.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The Vacuum Collapse: an explosion played in reverse, collapsing into a singular point of truth.
scenes.company_style: Flat parallax on muted archival tan canvas with faded grid, bold condensed type, and hot-red marker underline.
scenes.camera: Fast lateral track then hard stop with overshoot (COUNTER_SLAM).
scenes.transition: Red marker underline pulls tight like a thread (THREAD_PULL) and snaps into a horizontal baseline coordinate.
scenes.sound: Sudden vacuum cut of noise, 50 Hz sub-bass drop, crisp paper friction snap.

scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom doesn't guess. It unites the collective intelligence of 1,482,930 trader inputs.
scenes.visual_argument: Hundreds of individual trader cutouts light up across a tactile paper map, each feeding a red signal thread into a central convergence hub, synchronizing into a single golden vector.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Thousands of disparate human whispers resolving into one coherent, undeniable voice.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama with archival topographic map, B&W halftone cutouts of traders across global capitals, and giant stat numbers.
scenes.camera: Dives through the topographic map layer, orbiting a quarter turn to reveal network depth.
scenes.transition: The last digit '0' of 1,482,930 expands outward into a circular radar scope.
scenes.sound: Submerge whoosh, mechanical counter ticks (TICK_UP), harmonic chime resolve.

scenes.narration: Delivering 68.4 percent directional accuracy—tested and verified across four hundred twenty-eight tickers.
scenes.visual_argument: A giant dual-card statistical proof stage comparing CrowdWisdom's 68.4% accuracy directly against market noise with institutional authority.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A precision balance scale locking into undeniable empirical equilibrium.
scenes.company_style: Locked stage archival canvas with giant stat card stamping down (STAMP) with offset red marker keyline.
scenes.camera: Subtle slow drift lateral, maintaining locked architectural stability.
scenes.transition: The decimal point in 68.4% pulses, extruding a horizontal timeline ruler into the next scene.
scenes.sound: Heavy stamp thud, acoustic stock exchange bell strike (440/880 Hz), mechanical clock tick.

scenes.narration: With 14.6 hours of early warning lead. Seeing the institutional pivot before the candlestick breaks.
scenes.visual_argument: A clock hand sweeps across a split candlestick chart, highlighting the 14.6-hour gap between crowd sentiment shift and eventual price breakdown.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Seeing the flash of lightning long before the thunderclap arrives.
scenes.company_style: Flat parallax with 24-hour timeline ruler, candlestick chart layer, and giant mustard annotation.
scenes.camera: Fast lateral track along the timeline path like a rail, locking onto the divergence gap.
scenes.transition: The sentiment divergence arrow pivots 90 degrees to form the crosshair of the platform.
scenes.sound: Riser sweep, alert wash deep sub thud, mechanical track rumble.

scenes.narration: From noise, to signal, to execution. You stop trading in the dark.
scenes.visual_argument: The solitary trader from Scene 1 reappears, but now the chaotic red screens are replaced by clean, golden CrowdWisdom intelligence vectors; he executes calmly before the public breakout.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The dark room filling with morning clarity and unshakeable conviction.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama trading room illuminated by warm archival light, calm trader cutout, floating +ALPHA tags.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in past foreground floating tags directly to the calm trader.
scenes.transition: The execution button transforms into the CrowdWisdom seal lockup.
scenes.sound: Clean keyboard enter key stroke, warm resonant chime resolve, room tone settling.
